title: Heuristic Lab: Weekmap + 'Fermion' smoke harness (release week draft)
content:
Context and purpose:
This is a compact, tactical weekmap for the next release window. It pairs a lightweight rollout calendar with the temporary 'Fermion' smoke harness (a minimal inference path for low-latency checks), a short checklist for day-of ops, and a first-draft release-notes section. Intent is to be readable on a single screen during handoffs; treat as living notes that will be copied into the canonical release brief after dry run.

High-level goals:
- Validate end-to-end request path under realistic short-burst traffic (Fermion harness).
- Ensure latency SLOs (p50/p95) and error budget shape during 0->30% traffic ramp.
- Confirm fallback routing and model-variant switch works (hosted -> dedicated -> fallback quantized).
- Capture any behavioral/regression items for the post-rollout evaluation list.

Quick glossary
- Fermion: name for the lightweight smoke harness that exercises token-prefix cache + streaming path (1-2 token replies).
- Microwindow: short (15-30m) controlled ramp steps used in the calendar.
- Watchlist: signal thresholds that should trigger manual hold/rollback.

Weekmap (day-by-day, local PST)
Mon 2026-06-14 – Preflight & Dry Run - 09:00: dry run with Fermion in staging (5k requests over 30m, sequence len 64)
- 10:15: quick triage, validate service-level smoke scripts green
- 13:00: obs + cost leads review (telemetry sanity, sampling rates)
- 16:00: preflight signoff meeting (SRE, Release Eng, Runtime leads)
Tue 2026-06-15 – Canary microwindow 0->1%
- 08:30: deploy canary build to canary lane; knobs: batching=auto, cache=on
- 09:00: start Microwindow A (15m) at 0.1% traffic then 1%
- 09:20: validate Fermion latency p50 <120ms, p95 <350ms; errors <0.5%
- 10:00: guardrail decision and escalate if thresholds breached
- 14:00: analysis of telemetry (heatmap + trace samples)
Wed 2026-06-16 – Canary 1% -> 5%
- 08:00: start Microwindow B (30m) ramp 1% -> 5%
- 08:40: run a targeted quality eval set (prompt regression smoke)
- 09:30: verify fallback route and model-variant fallback flows by inducing a single-instance dropout in staging edge
- 12:00: midday sync; short list of anomalies recorded
Thu 2026-06-17 – 5% -> 15% burst and soak
- 07:30: staggered regional ramp (NA -> EU), watch regional latencies
- 08:15: enable limited burst autoscale policy for dedicated pool
- 11:00: soak window start (2hr) at 15% with periodic Fermion probes
- 15:30: rollback drill rehearsal (manual & automated)
Fri 2026-06-18 – 15% -> 30% and release notes freeze
- 09:00: final ramp to 30% if steady; otherwise pause and analyze
- 10:30: release-notes first pass (see draft below)
- 13:00: run full smoke tests + canary tear-down prep
- 16:00: post-rollout ops checklist handoff for next-week watch

Day-of ops quick checklist (to be printed on shift cards)
- Preflight: verify deploy artifacts match signed commit and release tag
- Observability: make sure dashboards in 'release/fermion' are loaded and owner pinned
- Traffic knobs: confirm throttle curve and canary keys are set in routing config
- Telemetry: confirm sample rates for traces = 100% for fermion paths, 5% for full traffic
- Tracing: enable request-id forwarding and capture 50 traces/min for first hour
- Rollback: know rollback commit, rollback window length, and the smoke-fail metric to watch

Watchlist (signal thresholds – if any fire, call release lead + SRE immediately)
- Error rate (5m window) > 1.0% absolute increase over baseline
- p95 latency increases > 2x baseline or > 1s absolute
- Key customer API errors (401/403/500) > 10/min sustained for 5m
- Telemetry dropouts (no ingestion for any region)
- Quality regressions: automated eval set BLEU/ROUGE drop > predefined threshold or > 5 prompts failing manual review

Fermion smoke harness notes
- Lightweight client that issues small streaming completions and a short embed request combo to exercise code paths
- Config: concurrency=20, sequence=64, prefix-cache=on, batch-window-ms=8
- Expected baseline: p50 75–110ms, p95 250–320ms on dedicated pool machines
- Logs: fermion-smoke logs stream to release-smoke.log with request-id and trace link

Suggested telemetry queries (promql / pseudo queries)
- rolling_error_rate = sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"api\",route=~\"/v1/generate.*\"}[5m])) by (region,route) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"api\"}[5m]))
- fermion_latency_p95 = histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=\"fermion-smoke\"}[5m])) by (le))
- cache_hit_ratio = sum(rate(cache_hits_total[5m])) / (sum(rate(cache_hits_total[5m])) + sum(rate(cache_misses_total[5m])))

Rollback decision matrix (compact)
- Immediate rollback: error rate >1% absolute and p95 > 1s for 10m
- Hold traffic: p95 consistently > 2x baseline but < 1s, or quality eval flakiness in >3/20 prompts
- Proceed with ramp: metrics within watchlist thresholds for 30m of steady traffic

Release notes — first draft (to be refined)
- Feature: model routing policy update — enables per-customer latency-tier routing and automatic fallback to quantized variants when dedicated pool is saturated.
- Improvement: streaming latency optimizations in the serving runtime (reduced p50 by ~10–15% on average).
- Fix: resolved a rare KV-cache duplication on hot-shard rollover that could cause elevated memory usage under sustained long-sequence workloads.
- Known issues: some customers with strict rate limits might see a short-lived 429 spike during regional ramp; mitigation: rate-shape smoothing applied to canary policy.

Notes, open questions and todos
- TODO: finalize fermion config and add to ci-release smoke stage (Jules)
- TODO: add one synthetic customer workload to the canary cohort to better represent bursty dialogs (Sofia)
- Question: should trace sampling for fermion be retained at 100% after 30% ramp? proposal: drop to 25% after 2hr soak
- Capture: weave sample traces into postmortem template if anything requires rollback

Quick retrospective checklist (post-release)
- Capture 6x perf snapshots (pre, 0%, 1%, 5%, 15%, 30%) and store under /telemetry/releases/2026-06-18/fermion
- Run automated quality eval suite with full prompt set and tag failing prompts into RE-1789
- Convene 60m debrief within 24h with SRE, Runtime, Product, and CS for customer-impact triage

Bottom line: this doc is intended to be a concise operational companion for the week. Keep the Fermion harness small but high-signal, keep canary microwindows short and well-instrumented, and err on the side of pausing the ramp if you see novel telemetry signals.

Field scribbles (notes-to-self style)
- fermion endpoint: /internal/smoke/fermion -> needs auth token rotation check
- local debug tip: set SAMPLE_PROMPT=short_dialog_1 for quick dev loop
- preflight checklist link: confluence page pinned in linked_artifacts

-- end of draft --
